name: sigmora
description: Edit, caption, render and schedule short-form video from a conversation. Your assistant plans and writes; Sigmora does the media work in your own Sigmora workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Sigmora turns your conversation into finished short-form video. Bring in footage from a file or a link, and Sigmora finds the moments worth cutting, edits out filler words and long pauses, adds captions, reshapes clips for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, and posts or schedules them to the social accounts you connected.

You stay in control. Edits come back as proposals you approve before anything renders, every paid step shows its cost and your balance before it runs, and nothing is posted until you confirm the account, caption and time.

Your assistant does the planning and writing, guided by Sigmora's playbooks for hooks, scripts, captions and platform copy. Sigmora does the media work in your own Sigmora workspace, using your existing account and credits. Fine-tune any project in the Sigmora editor at sigmora.org.
defaultPrompt: Cut my podcast episode into three 45-second vertical shorts with captions.
Remove the ums and long pauses from my latest video.
Schedule my finished clip to TikTok for tomorrow at 9am.

positive.prompt: Cut this 20-minute podcast into three 45-second vertical shorts with captions.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attached podcast, finds the strongest moments, quotes the edit with the credit cost and balance, and after the reviewer agrees starts the edit and reports the job until the cuts are ready for approval.

positive.description: Clean up filler words and pauses
positive.prompt: Take my last upload and remove the ums and long pauses.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest project, proposes removing the filler words and tightening the long pauses without changing anything yet, shows the proposals, and applies them only after the reviewer agrees. Both edits are free and can be undone.

positive.prompt: Add captions to my project and make it 60 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, proposes trimming it to about 60 seconds and adding captions, shows the projected length, and applies the proposals only after the reviewer agrees. Both edits are free and can be undone.

positive.prompt: Make a finished 60-second cut of my latest video that I can download.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the latest video, quotes a rendered 60-second cut with the credit cost and balance, and after the reviewer agrees starts it and reports the job until the video is ready to play and download.

positive.description: Clips with hooks from a YouTube link
positive.prompt: Turn this YouTube link into five short clips with hooks.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the link, picks five moments, writes a hook for each following Sigmora's playbook, and quotes the edit before running it.

positive.prompt: Schedule the finished clip to TikTok and Reels for tomorrow at 9am.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected TikTok and Instagram accounts, confirms each account, the caption and the time with the reviewer, then schedules the posts and reports each as scheduled or pending approval.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about the sea.
How do I edit a photo in Photoshop?

review.commerce_description: Sigmora sells nothing inside ChatGPT. Media work draws on the credits of the person's existing Sigmora account; plans are described and managed on sigmora.org.
